text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let us determine who is the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah...
——... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...?? Um... what...?
I'm in the middle of a run, but...
What is this about? So suddenly...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Looking at your straight hair, it struck me.
A straight line just like mine, frictionless just like mine.
You are truly worthy as a fellow pursuer of top speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Do you not wish to find out?
"Top Speed" vs. "Functional Beauty of the Fastest".

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Which of us will run fastest, closest to light,
and behold the view from the lead at maximum velocity——

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Sudden as it may be, that's one thing I won't back down on.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
Let's decide right here who is "fastest".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The start signal will be when that train
reaches the bridge.
Goal: all the way to that flag.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No objections. Here we go——!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Tch, as expected of the straight hair I acknowledged!
Zero wasted motion from start to top speed!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(She truly lives up to being called top speed...
She stays right beside me, I can't shake her off!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Faster, I need more speed...
Ah, but this is...!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Running this fast... feels...!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ufufu...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What!? Have you lost your mind!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it——

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It just feels so good...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
!? Where are you going, lead fanatic!
The goal isn't in that direction——

text_block_list.name: Runaway Ostrich
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hah! An ostrich!?
Sprinting in a dead straight line——
Have you also come to challenge my top speed...!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, you top out at a mere 70 km/h!
I am faster!

text_block_list.name: Person Chasing Ostrich
text_block_list.text:
Wait!? Hold on!
Somebody catch it~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Fast, she was far too fast...
The view from the lead took so long to reach...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...I've finally reached you.
The view from the lead. I'm truly so happy.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Light O——thank you.
For bringing me this far.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait... huh? Light O...? 
Or rather... wh-where is this——!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds,
I overheard a rather curious conversation...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? You raced an ostrich...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It provoked me incessantly, so I put it in its place.
It's your fault for wandering off on your own
and missing out on such an exhilarating opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, not really...
Though now that you mention it, maybe it is a bit of a shame...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I think about it, I can't figure it out.
It seems the world still holds many mysteries I know nothing about...
